title: Fastest Lead Time
question: Which supplier delivers fastest on average?

facts: SUP-001 (Somchai Mango Farm) is fastest at ~3 days average
SUP-001: PO-001 3 days, PO-004 2 days, PO-006 3 days = avg 2.7 days
SUP-003 (Prachuap Harvest): ~6 days average (PO-003 4 days, PO-007 8 days)
SUP-002 (Northern Fruits Co.): ~8 days average (PO-002 8 days, PO-005 9 days)
SUP-001 is nearly 3x faster than SUP-002
